objects.name: Client
objects.definition: An organisation BAS delivers consulting or advisory work to.

objects.name: Client Stakeholder
objects.definition: A named individual within a client who holds a need, a decision or an approval.

objects.name: Learner
objects.definition: An individual enrolled in a BAS course, workshop or study community.

objects.name: Practitioner
objects.definition: A BAS consultant, facilitator, author or associate who performs the work.

objects.name: Partner
objects.definition: An organisation BAS co-delivers, co-markets or co-publishes with.

objects.name: Vendor
objects.definition: A supplier of platform, tooling or services BAS consumes.

objects.name: Service Offering
objects.definition: A named, priced consulting or training product in the BAS portfolio.

objects.name: Methodology
objects.definition: The BA practice model, standards, framework mappings and AI governance policy set.

objects.name: IP Asset
objects.definition: Reusable intellectual property: playbooks, templates, publications and visual assets.

objects.name: Course
objects.definition: A curriculum with its courseware, scheduled cohorts and sessions.

objects.name: Platform Component
objects.definition: Software, environments, releases, tests, accounts and subscriptions making up the BAS platform.

objects.name: Brand Content
objects.definition: Brand identity, marketing content items and campaign assets.

objects.name: Opportunity
objects.definition: Demand from an identified or prospective client, from first enquiry through proposal.

objects.name: Contract
objects.definition: The agreed statement of work and commercial terms authorising delivery.

objects.name: Engagement
objects.definition: An instance of consulting delivery against a contract.

objects.name: Requirement
objects.definition: An elicited and specified need, including the models and solution options evaluated against it.

objects.name: Deliverable
objects.definition: An artefact produced for and accepted by a client, including status reports.

objects.name: Enrolment
objects.definition: A learner's registration, attendance, assessment result and certification for a course.

objects.name: Outcome & Insight
objects.definition: Measured results and learning: benefits realised, feedback, retrospectives, research findings and usage metrics.

objects.name: Financial Transaction
objects.definition: Invoices raised, payments received and the financial records derived from them.

objects.name: Risk & Change Record
objects.definition: Risks, issues, change requests and incidents raised against delivery or the platform.

objects.name: Compliance Record
objects.definition: Retained records evidencing regulatory, privacy and licensing obligations.
